exercises.title: Define disjointness
exercises.objective: Express that two sets have no common element.

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} : Set α → Set α → Prop := T1.MyDisjoint
checks.message: Keep the name and type: `MyDisjoint (s t : Set α) : Prop`.

hints.hint: Use a universal statement: for every `x`, membership in both sets is impossible.
